scope: Human-authorized original BGK Mach3-5, Pr1, mu proportional T, tau=1/rho. Same native map as the verified Mach2 solver. Cold RH mixtures, no borrowed stationarity credit. Baseline profiles require measured stationarity and later sensitivity checks; successful exit or tmax alone does not qualify a result.
reference: Fei et al. 2020, DOI 10.2514/1.J059029, upstream T300K and omega1, standard BGK Pr1. Dimensionless rho1=T1=mu1=1. Compare density in the physical mean-free-path convention, not by identifying it with the thermal relaxation length.
